findings.description: The repeating unit counts of 2,853,659 and 2,856,659 and the flat $1,170,000 valuation across four different clients (HeadFarm LLC in July 2023; CountSharp LLC, CupCrew LLC, and RealWorld LLC in October 2023) represent an artificial revenue generation scheme using predetermined, non-arm's length valuations of $1,170,000 to inflate revenues and balance sheet assets.

findings.title: Netcapital Inc. artificially inflated its reported revenues and profitability by recording non-cash consulting services
findings.description: Netcapital Inc. artificially inflated its reported revenues and profitability by recording non-cash consulting services paid in highly illiquid, overvalued equity units of its own crowdfunding clients, using arbitrary valuations that resulted in massive accrual-cash divergences and repeated identical transaction figures across multiple counterparties.

findings.title: The identical figures of 2,856,659 units and $1,170,000 valuations across CountSharp LLC, CupCrew LLC, and RealWorld LLC
findings.description: The identical figures of 2,856,659 units and $1,170,000 valuations across CountSharp LLC, CupCrew LLC, and RealWorld LLC in the October 2023 disclosures are clerical copy-paste errors made during the preparation of the Form 10-Q for the period ended October 31, 2023, where the financial reporting team replicated the disclosures of one transaction for the other two.
